sources.title: Karnak-40B-v1.0 · Model · Inferix
sources.snippet: Karnak is a depth-extended causal language model optimized for Arabic and English generation. It is built on top of Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B-Instruct-2507, featuring architectural depth extension and a tokenizer specifically optimized for Arabic to improve fluency and efficiency.
